title: Machado Returns to Venezuela as Trump Backs Rodríguez
dek: The opposition leader returns after nearly a year abroad, with no election date set.
body: Machado reappeared at a church in Lara and drove to Caracas. Trump says the US will keep working with Rodríguez.

panels.label: Machado's Camp Says
panels.text: Machado's adviser says she will push for a date for free and fair elections.

panels.label: Washington Says
panels.text: Trump says “we're doing really well in Venezuela”; Rubio says talks are the best path to an election.

panels.label: The Stakes
panels.text: Both camps say they want elections; at stake is who sets the date and who controls Venezuela's oil until then.
